title: Silver Thief
personality:
The thief who reached the Wyrmheart in Malgrave's vault. Touching it woke the Wyrm and set off the Hollowing.
Everyone has a reason to hate her, and she knows it. She's still after the treasure.
fantasy: The duelist. Sticks to one mark from range, cartwheels past them, never lets go.
silhouette: the long braid, the moth wings and the twin pistols

card.loop: Ranged duelist: stay on one foe, cartwheel, and land the big shot.
card.dash: Cartwheel a short way (much further from a jump). Your next shot is empowered, a gold glint in your throwing hand: a big shot that, if it lands, gives you the Vault back at once.
card.passive: Each hit on the same foe adds a Mark: +10% damage, with no cap. Knocks heal you.
card.x: A ring opens round you: for 2s blades fly at every foe in it, harder and blighting from its edge.
card.rmb: A short wind-up, then a Bola down the lane: it grounds and slows the first foe and flies on. Catch a second and both are stunned.
card.e: Throw a dagger to your cursor or into a foe. Press E again to blink to it.

weapons.arc_bolts: Bolts from alternating hands every 0.45s. Each one lands at your cursor.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Every shot that hits puts a Mark on the target (no cap, each lasting 4s and refreshed by the next): your shots on them deal +10% per Mark. The empowered shot adds 2, the Bola 1. A knock heals you 15% of your health on top of the usual knock heal (25% in all) and bursts a crimson star on them; an assist heals 25%.

dash.name: Vault
dash.desc: A sideways cartwheel of 4.5m the way you move in about half a second (about 8m from a jump, its speed carried to the landing; shots pass through it; you can shoot mid-flip) and +18% speed for 2s. Your next shot within 3s is empowered (a gold glint in your throwing hand, flaring as you land): it flies 12% further and deals 2.3 times a shot and puts 2 Marks on them (Marks add to it as to any shot); firing it ends the speed. Landing it gives the Vault back at once. Rank 2: the empowered bonus +20%; rank 3: +40%.

variants.tap: A 0.4s wind-up with the lane showing (you keep aiming), then the Bola flies 7m: 5 damage and a Mark; the first foe it wraps is Grounded for 1.5s (no dash, jump or glide) and slowed 30%, and the Bola flies on 3.8m (a crate it breaks counts as that first catch). It bounces once off a wall. If it catches a second foe, both are stunned 0.9 and take +13 (TANGLED).
variants.air: Thrown from the air the same way.

e.name: Shadow Knife
e.desc: Throw a dagger to your cursor (14m at most): it sticks in the first foe on the way (8 damage, slowed 50% for 2.5s) or lands where you aimed. Press E again to blink to it at once, leaving a trail of afterimages; after 6s you step to it anyway.

x.name: Encore
x.desc: A violet ring grows round you (0.4s) to 5.4m and rides with you; she dances, and for 2s a blade flies from her hands every 0.2s at each foe inside it (10 at most): 4 each, 6 from the outer band (past 4m), which also blights them for 6s (healing barely takes). You keep moving, shooting and dashing; casting it gives the Vault back, and every blade refreshes your Marks. Allies are untouched.

rank3.sec: flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks
rank3.dash: the empowered bonus +40% in all, and the Vault's speed boost is half again as big
rank3.kin: sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe), and a knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge 4.5s -> 3.8s per charge; the empowered bonus +20%.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 5.6s, damage +30%; flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 15s -> 12s, damage +30%; sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe), and a knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 4.5s -> 3.2s; the empowered bonus +40% in all, and the speed boost is half again as big.

tells.half: gold Mark diamonds over the target, one per stack
tells.full: a full ring of eight diamonds spinning fast (more Marks still count); a gold glint in the hand and a gold aim line while the next shot is empowered; a violet ring round her and blades circling her while Encore runs
tells.dash_spent: a white cartwheel arc, dash pip dark; a landed empowered shot flashes the pip back with RESET at her hand
